items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: And Johnny Letmann had the band.

ctx.x: Joe Hughes' Club De Luxe. 63rd and South Park. And Johnny Letmann had the band. So Roy came in town.

Now, the local Negroes couldn't work in the Loop without Petrillo's permission. He wasn't about to give his permission, even some of the jobs on the West Side we had to petition for, to get his permission. So Roy says, "I'm opening at the Capital Lounge." That was right next door to the Capital Theatre. I said, "What? Going downtown? Oh, goody, goody, goody, goody."
